in_marathi.name: Behula
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Forgiveness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Behula हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Behula is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘behuh’ meaning ‘love’ and ‘ula’ meaning ‘boat’. This name is associated with the goddess Behula Devi, who is revered for her qualities of love, forgiveness, and grace. In Hindu mythology, she is said to have rescued Lord Krishna and his brother Balarama from the river Jamuna in a boat.
